documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, with standalone revenue at INR 247.03 crores and consolidated revenue at INR 269.23 crores. Management highlighted that export sales and growth momentum are expected to continue over the next two to three years, supported by orders from U.S. and European markets. The company is adding a new production line in its current premises, expected to start production by February or March 2027, while evaluations for an international plant are ongoing due to market volatility. Management also noted that capacity utilization currently ranges between 75% and 78%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that sales growth and increased momentum are expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic value growth between 8% and 10%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%.

guidance.claim: The company expects export value growth between 15% and 20%.
guidance.quote: And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects operating margins to be maintained between 25% and 30%.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

guidance.claim: The company has kept a potential outlook for a 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue value should grow by 15% for the next 2 years while margins remain at a similar level.
guidance.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the footwear market was muted due to a drastic increase in sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that very positive sentiments are coming from the European market following the FTA signed by India.
demand_outlook.quote: Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that current capacity utilization is running between 75% to 78%.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that more growth is expected to come from the automotive sector in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: The polyurethane (PU) business demand remains muted and business has not matured yet.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth rather than growth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that a new line has been ordered for expansion in the current premises with production expected to start around February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the upcoming plant expansion in current premises will add an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management highlighted that potential locations for an overseas plant include Mexico, the U.S., or other NAFTA areas, though a final call has not been taken due to market volatility.
capex_expansion.quote: So it could be in Mexico, it could be in U.S., it could be in some other NAFTA areas. We are still considering various options, but there's so much of volatility in the market. So it's not easy to decide where exactly we should put the plant right now.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new coating line to be set up within an existing facility rather than putting it in South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure for the global location is estimated around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: If the company undertakes capex on a global scale outside India, it will cost INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once a decision is taken for the South plant, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant expansion will start initially with 500,000 millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable margins are expected to be 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that last quarter's margins were abnormally high due to an abnormal increase in foreign exchange rates.
margins_costs.quote: But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates. So that was a onetime increase basically.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that shipment costs for exports increased significantly, reaching 4x higher due to the Gulf war.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management mentioned that a 10% natural hedge occurred due to US dollar appreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Right? If today I was selling material for US$8 and I was having realization of 85 to 86, so at 94 I was getting a 10% natural hedge.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and consumable expenses.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter compared to the previous year, contributing to better margins.
margins_costs.quote: our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange gains from dollar price increases contributed significantly to margins.
margins_costs.quote: And secondly, this foreign exchange gain is also giving impact because of increase in dollar prices. So, export is giving much contribution to our margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that import raw materials normally account for nearly 1/3 of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that around 50% of other income this quarter came from foreign exchange gain.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company received good OEM supply orders from the U.S.A., contributing to export sales and profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line capacity is expected to increase revenue by INR 120 crores to INR 150 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr. And that much meter, we have given approximately figure.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and the West Asia war as unpredictable factors affecting raw material pricing and operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: No one knows what will happen with the West Asia war tomorrow. Things look very stable right now. So obviously, whatever projections we give, we give based on our normal market situations. Certain situations are not in our control, which we cannot predict right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that international expansion decisions face delays due to market volatility, Trump tariffs, and West Asia conflicts.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC increased significantly as a petroleum by-product, causing initial supply challenges in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impacts on raw material cost take a month or so to pass on to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an endeavor to make the company a preferred supplier for leading OEMs in overseas markets, especially the U.S. and European regions.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavor is to make the company as a preferred supplier for the leading OEMs in overseas market, especially the U.S. and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans for regular plantations on a larger scale in coming years under CSR programs.
management_commitments.quote: Under the corporate social responsibility programs, we have contributed towards regular plantations around 50,000 plants already done and have a plan to do it at larger scale in coming years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export momentum and growth to continue.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The coating line at the existing location is expected to be completed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased export momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to continue large-scale regular plantation under CSR programs in coming years.
management_commitments.quote: Under the Corporate Social Responsibility programs, we have contributed towards the regular plantation, around 45,000 and more plants already we have planted and have a plan to do it at large scale in coming years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
